name: Eschbach Dam
scope: Whole Eschbach masonry gravity dam in approximate circa1892 original design appearance: complete native54-control dam wall with curved batter, full crest walkway and parapets, repeated downstream corbel arcade, central octagonal valve pavilion and roof, end turrets, intrinsic20moverflow and stepped spillway connection, and central low-level outlet. Excludes reservoir water/natural shores, remote pumpstation/pipelines/filtergrounds/roads/nearbybuildings. Historic original-design detail and actual initial completion registration are approximate, not a current2026 replacement or an exact as-built survey.
